#!/bin/bash
# Differential test: compare the Python executable against the Node port.
EXE=/workspace/dataset/test11_executable
JS="node /output/test11.mjs"
pass=0; fail=0

check() {
  local desc="$1"; shift
  local pyout pyerr pyrc jsout jserr jsrc
  pyout=$("$EXE" "$@" 2>/tmp/pyerr); pyrc=$?; pyerr=$(cat /tmp/pyerr)
  jsout=$(node /output/test11.mjs "$@" 2>/tmp/jserr); jsrc=$?; jserr=$(cat /tmp/jserr)
  # normalise the program name, which legitimately differs
  pyerr=${pyerr//test11_executable/PROG}
  jserr=${jserr//test11.mjs/PROG}
  if [[ "$pyout" == "$jsout" && "$pyrc" == "$jsrc" && "$pyerr" == "$jserr" ]]; then
    pass=$((pass+1)); echo "PASS  $desc"
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL  $desc  args=[$*]"
    echo "  py rc=$pyrc out=[$pyout] err=[$pyerr]"
    echo "  js rc=$jsrc out=[$jsout] err=[$jserr]"
  fi
}
